SELECT [SourcetEntityId]
      ,[EntityName]
      ,[EntitySetName]
      ,[PrimaryIdAttribute]
      ,[MetadataId]
      ,[InUse]
  FROM [dbo].[EntityMetadata]
  where EntityName 
  in (
    'sfa_contract',
	'sfa_unitofprocurement',
	'account',
	'sfa_contractallocation',
	'sfa_status',
	'sfa_subnominalaggregation',
	'sfa_contractdeliverable',
	'sfa_fundingstreamperiod',
	'sfa_contractdeliverableperiod',
	'sfa_fundingtype',
	'sfa_fundingstreamperioddeliverable',
  'sfa_contracttransitionhistory',
  'sfa_Agency',
  'sfa_FundingClaimReconciliation'
     ) 
  and InUse=1

scripts.text:
UPDATE dbo.CRMEntityAttributeMetadata SET
Mapping = '{"source":{"path":"[''' + 
    case when AttributeTypeName in ('LookupType','CustomerType','OwnerType') then CONCAT('_',AttributeName,'_value') else AttributeName end + ''']"},"sink":{"name":"' + AttributeName + '","type":"' + 
    case when AttributeTypeName = 'BigIntType' then 'Int64' 
    when AttributeTypeName = 'MoneyType' then 'Decimal'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'IntegerType' then 'Int32'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'EntityNameType' then 'String'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'StateType' then 'Int32'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'StatusType' then 'Int32'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'CustomerType' then 'Guid'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'PicklistType' then 'Int32'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'MultiSelectPicklistType' then 'String'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'UniqueidentifierType' then 'Guid'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'MemoType' then 'String'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'LookupType' then 'Guid'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'ManagedPropertyType' then 'String'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'OwnerType' then 'Guid'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'VirtualType' then 'String'
    when AttributeTypeName = 'PartyListType' then 'String'
    else left(AttributeTypeName, len(AttributeTypeName)-4) end + '"}}';

scripts.text:
with cte AS(
SELECT a.EntityName,
b.EntitySetName,
CASE WHEN a.AttributeTypeName in ('LookupType','CustomerType','OwnerType') THEN CONCAT('_',AttributeName,'_value') ELSE a.AttributeName END as AttributeName,
b.PrimaryIdAttribute,
a.Mapping,
a.AttributeTypeName,
a.AdditionalcolumnsMapping,
b.DeltaMarkerAttribute,
FORMAT(CAST(b.DeltaMarker AS DATETIME2), 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss') + 'Z' AS DeltaMarker,
b.IsDeltaLoad,
b.SourcetEntityId
from [dbo].[CRMEntityAttributeMetadata] a with (nolock) join [dbo].[EntityMetadata] b with (nolock) on a.EntityName = b.EntityName
where ((a.AttributeTypeName not in ('VirtualType','PartyListType','ImageType','EntityNameType') and a.IsValidForAdvancedFind=1) or a.IsPrimaryId=1)
and a.EntityName in 
(
	'sfa_contract',
	'sfa_unitofprocurement',
	'account',
	'sfa_contractallocation',
	'sfa_status',
	'sfa_subnominalaggregation',
	'sfa_contractdeliverable',
	'sfa_fundingstreamperiod',
	'sfa_contractdeliverableperiod',
	'sfa_fundingtype',
	'sfa_fundingstreamperioddeliverable',
	'sfa_contracttransitionhistory',
	'sfa_Agency',
	'sfa_FundingClaimReconciliation'
) 
and a.InUse=1 and b.InUse=1
)

SELECT EntityName,EntitySetName,PrimaryIdAttribute,DeltaMarkerAttribute,SourcetEntityId,
case when DeltaMarker is null then convert(varchar(51), DATEADD(HOUR, 0, CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()-15))), 127) + 'Z' else  DeltaMarker end as DeltaMarker,                                         /*'2022-10-31T20:00:00Z'*/
IsDeltaLoad,'Id' as UpsertKey,
STRING_AGG(CONVERT(nvarchar(max),AttributeName),',') as Query,
'{"type":"TabularTranslator","mappings":['+'{"source":{"path":"['''+PrimaryIdAttribute+''']"},"sink":{"name":"Id","type":"Guid"}},' + STRING_AGG(CONVERT(nvarchar(max),Mapping),',')+'],"collectionReference":"$[''value'']","mapComplexValuesToString":true}' as Mapping,
'['+ STRING_AGG(CONVERT(nvarchar(max),AdditionalcolumnsMapping),',')+']' as AdditionalColumnMapping
from cte where Mapping!=''
group by EntityName,EntitySetName,PrimaryIdAttribute,DeltaMarkerAttribute,DeltaMarker,IsDeltaLoad,SourcetEntityId
